independence.method: verify recursive seals; independently reconstruct directed masks, occupancy and replay conservation; parse sealed VCS/SVA receipts; substitute the current serial FSM cadence into the sealed M225 aggregate ledger; inspect read-only DC snapshot

cycle_recurrence_audit.why: ST_REQUEST, ST_WAIT and ST_REPLAY are mutually exclusive; versus the M225 service recurrence, every unique weight-vector read adds at least two non-update cycles and no next-source transaction overlaps replay
cycle_recurrence_audit.required_repair: decoupled walker/request/response/replay with next-weight prefetch, at least two held-weight slots and explicit credits

directed_cycle_observation_not_performan.reason: testbench inserts scan-beat gaps, variable response latency and variant-dependent request/result stall phase

p0_findings.finding: The current serial request/wait/replay FSM does not execute the M226 performance recurrence.
p0_findings.impact: The sealed 1.568695x/2.112902x priors cannot be claimed as M227 RTL speedup; a zero-stall minimum substitution yields only 1.262957x/1.433702x.
p0_findings.required_action: Pipeline walker, request, response and replay with next-weight prefetch and remeasure the exact H67 trace through the executable schedule.

p0_findings.finding: Matched DC is incomplete: F1 was externally killed in pass-1 mapping and F2/F4 never started.
p0_findings.impact: There is no area, timing, throughput/area or power admission.
p0_findings.required_action: Repair the architecture first, then rerun fail-closed matched DC and admit only timing-clean points.

p1_findings: Only three directed groups and two nonempty groups per variant are tested.
Wrong response identity, early scan-done, busy begin and sign-not-subset attacks are not directly covered.
Numeric-overflow sticky fail-close and Acc19 boundaries are not exercised.
Partial output blocks are not represented; this is one fixed 96-lane slice, not complete FC1.
Full-flop masks/accumulators, broad clear and wide dynamic muxes require structural optimization before another three-variant DC run.
DC VER-318 signed/unsigned conversions remain without mapped-netlist Formality.
p2_findings: The full8_sources TB counter counts qualifying nonempty groups, not full-eight sources.
Done backpressure and legal out-of-order scan are not covered.
The fail marker records runner_exit_code=0 despite a logged SIGTERM; the run is correctly non-citable but automation metadata is inconsistent.
